--- Page 5 --- "la kitap ang' teachership-o enia maapa baksa damsan ongengmiting salrangko gisik ra'aniona ongchina" --- Page 7 --- JANAPCHENGANI A.chik a-songo kitap sena changgiparang bang-heen dongaha indiba ku-tangchi segimin kitaprangko poraina sikgiparang bangjani gimin bang-batan sena siktokja.
lan an chingni ku-tangna ka-sagijaniko mesokani gita ong a.
Anga ia Novel-ko ruuhea salrangna skangan scahachim indiba adita ncng-nikanirangchi chapa kaatningna man jaha.
la segunin golpo angni gisikiangoniko tarie seanisan ongaia enia jan kitapna ka'sagiparangna poraitobegipa ba jakkaltohegipa ongjanaba donga.
lan adita manderangni nangnikaniko gisikona sokate angna ka donganiko on-ahanichi chapa ka-ataniona sokaha.

lano janapgimin song ba mandeni bimingrang badiaba biap ba nandeko minga baksa apsan ong'genchimode uan maibakai ong gakanisan ongaigen, maina ian golpoo hak ra-giparangko dingtang maekate mesoknasan uarangko donaha.
la segimin golpoo darang a'gilsakni mandeni daka rikako ba kam cholonko nirikie uko janapna miksonganirangha dongja indiba basakoba saniha janggi tanganiona indaka obostarang sokbanaba donga.
indake sakgipin manderangni dakchaka gri saksan ong-engmittingo iano janapgimin kattarangchi una ka-dimeataniko on na man aba donga ine mangsonganinasa ong'a.
Anga iano adita kata gitalrangkoba jakkalaha.
jekai garini palo kolre., kitapni palo chapmong, koborni palo knanku enia uandake gipinrang.
A-chikni minganio bang-an miksongani gnang bimingrangko donaha, jekai.
matchu ha matnokrangni gisepo chubatgipa, matcha ba matshako cha'gipa.
Ulandake biterangonikoha te-rik ba rongsa ronggipinko rika gita nanggipa bite, te-gatchu ba a-oni chukalao gata gita nanggipa bite ine mniksonga gnang minge jakkala.
Indake bimangni kri an-ching A-chik ku'siko dongkugijagipa kattarangko taridape jatni agananiko apalatna man'gen.
Bon-kame iako matchotsrange chusokatna dakchakahanina Ramsang Coilege-ni Lecturer Ma.
Martha Ch.
Momin (Department of Garo) enia Williamnagar College-ni ILecturer Pa.
Sengjrang N.
Sangma (Department of Garo) -ko mitelna namnikbea.

Uarangna agreba angna iako chusokatna jakko on'pae dakchakahanina pilak angni ripengskarangko enia iako bre'e poraigipa A-chik jat sakantikon mitela baksa pilak angni sikanirangko Sakni Gitelna pakwata.
Mitela.
Barnath A.
Sangma, Ex-Assistant Headmaster, Green Hill English School, Balsrigittim: Williamnagar Nokil A'we, Williamnagar, East Garo Hilis.
--- Page 9 --- [川] AGANDAPANI A-chikrangoba sena-jotna changgiparang bang'en gnang.
Saobarang iana ba-kapgipa gunrangba gnang, indioba basakobade an'tangtangari dal-droe silrorona neng-a.
Uaranga basakoba o-krie, chiru-a:gate.
dilneng-do-mikako man'ode silrorona aro namgipa biterangko nangna man'a.
An'ching uandakgiparangko an-tangtangari dal-ako nie dongaigija nirok-simsake nambatatna nanga.
Patigimin ba-kapgipa gunrangko nambatatna A-chikjat sakantian dakchakanirangko on:paode nambea.

Gipin ku-sikrango bang'a dingtang dingtang rokomni sea- jotanirang (literary genre) donggenchimoba A-chik ku'siko seanirangde namen komibcnga aro badiaba rokomni sea- jotanirangde dongsrangkuja ine aganoba gualani dongjawa.
Sea- jotani rokomrangoni Dakmesokna seani (Drama) aro gisiko golpo banaidrae Songsarni golpoko seani (Novel), uarangba mongsonggipa sea-jotanirang ong'a.
Uarangko college aro uni- versity-rango ra'naba nanga.
A-chikkuchi segimin songsarni golpo dao dipet Redin Mominni "Khalsin aro Sonatchi", Simison R.
Sangmani "Swarmalata"-oniko pe-gipa "Sonabal Me-chik", Icylian R.
Marakni "Chigitchakgreni Nokma" aro “"Gamseng", unbaksana da'o gital Prabodh M.
Sangmani “"Parakgija Ka'saa" aro “Dikreni Gitcham Poto" iarangsan ongkuainga.
Chasong damberangoni Te.
Barnath A.
Sangma songsarni golpo "SIKIME"-ko seaha.
lan chadamberangoni ia rokomni seanirangna re-mikkangani aro jaku de-ani ong'enga.
Ua iano gisiktango golpoko tarie ba gisiko golpoko rike uno bak ra'giparang (Character) -koba ia chasongoni ong-bewalo dakataha.

Songsarni golpo badiaba chasongo ong'a obostako janeraogita nikatna neck-tie kae juta gananiara ia chasongna ka-dingstekani ong'naba donga, indiba uko segipa mandeni chasongo mai ong-a uko photo- rangoniko nikode ong-bebea ine nikna man-a.

--- Page 10 --- [M] Janggitangani rakbegipa salsomoirang sokbaenganiko nisoe A-chik jatni dakrong-ka-rongkugijagipa jekon da-alonaba A.chikrang kae chakujaenga, uan juta sikani aro knirate cha'anirang ong'a, uarangkoba ua ia songsarni golpoo mesoke on'aha.
Beben A-chik me-chikrangoni me-chikskako kni ratani.
mikkang tariani kamrangko ka'e janggitanggiparangba dongengaha.
Minggipin ua iano ku-gipinchi minggimin bimungrangko ku-tango maidake banaie mingode ba donode namgenchim ba kragenchim uarangkoba banaie jakkale mesokaha.
Unigimin saobarang ua A-chikkuona banaigimin bimungrangko krae nikjaoba 'ong'niksrangja' ine jeaigija krae nikako una uiatode nambea.
Ku'tango sal, ja mingani dongoba anching kugipinko jakkale ku'tangchi mai minga ukode uija aro aganrongja.
Uarangko da-alo A-chikkuchi segipa songbadrango aro kitaprango jakkale mesokode, uarangko poraie gisikona chinaproroe knalo uko jatgimik jakkalna man'gen.
Sea-jotaniara chasongni chasongna gimakamgijagipa gam ong-a.
Chengo Greek skia man'giparang Pluto.
Aristotle uamangni seanirangko an'ching ia somoionaba poraie, uamangni chanchianirangko uina manenga.
Uarangara gamchatgipa hira, mukta aro sonana bateba gamchatbatsranggipa ong'a."SIKIME"- chadamberang gimagijagipa gam aro bimungna gisiknange jatna gimagijagipa gamko on'gilna jotton ka-na nanga.
Sea-jotani a-bao Dated: Williamnagar, The 13th July, 2002.
Sengjrang N.
Sangma.
Lecturer, Department of Garo Williamnagar College, Williamnagar
